summary.headline: Planetary Influences by Climate
summary.text: Discussion of planetary influence on the four mobile elements, earthly creatures, seeds, animals, human fortune, and misfortune, compared to a lodestone attracting iron. Chapter II explains how stellar effects vary by terrestrial climates and kingdoms, contrasting Ethiopia’s heat with the Slavs’ cold.
